name: Feature Request

assignees: ''

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. E.g., "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Pillar Relevance**
Which of the core starter pillars does this relate to?
- [ ] SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- [ ] AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
- [ ] LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)
- [ ] GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
- [ ] SSR / SSG (Server-Side Rendering / Static Site Generation)
- [ ] DX / Developer Experience & Tooling
- [ ] UI / Design System (Tailwind 4 / Material 3)

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup references, or links to specifications here.
